scope: Bounded rapid review: reproducible human CAII structure comparison, residue mapping, confidence interpretation, and audited export of a rigidly aligned existing model. Publication window 2022-01-01 through 2026-10-20; existing foundational citations retained.
inclusion_criteria: Primary database or method papers directly supporting mapping, confidence or structural comparison; official format and software sources for implementation behavior.
English text/metadata available through PubMed or official sites; dated window for discovery, with a seeded known 2023 mapping paper.
exclusion_criteria: Protein-specific activity, affinity, engineering or pathogen studies that do not establish the generic implementation contract.
Reviews/preprints not used as primary efficacy evidence; superseded database updates not reappraised.
No inference that structural overlap validates function, accuracy or independent generalization.

notes: Search responses provide full abstracts but only titles were screened for most exclusions; five records were separately retrieved for abstract appraisal.
No pooled effect estimates, formal risk-of-bias instrument, dual screening or citation chaining. This is not a complete systematic review.
Author-list pagination in two database-paper records was not followed because complete authorship was not required for scope screening.
